tactical_tasks_list.pull_method: Staleness threshold baked directly into the SQL WHERE clause (per-status age >= threshold) rather than pulling all 191 open rows client-side. Two queries required: first ORDER BY createdTime ASC LIMIT-capped at 100 rows (has_more:true), second WHERE createdTime > last-seen cutoff for the remaining 14. A COUNT(*) with the same staleness WHERE clause confirmed exactly 114 stale rows (100+14), matching.
